thread:
Anya: hey team — quick ask. trying to repro a customer issue; need to capture one full session (request + model response + token ids) to debug generation mismatch. planning to put the blob in an encrypted S3 bucket with a 7d TTL and strict IAM access. asking for temporary exemption from our prompt/response scrub rules for this one session. @Maria can you weigh in?

Maria: need a short justification and exact retention. who needs access? prod or staging? must never store raw user identifiers (hash or remove), redact emails/SSNs, and only approved people can access. legal sign-off required for regulated customers. :eyes:

Kevin: plan: single session capture, store in s3://redwood-debug/encrypted/<job-id>. metadata will include a sha256(customer_id) not plain user ids. access via IAM group eng-debug, MFA required. retention policy set to 7 days then lifecycle delete. capture config (will only flip for this job):

```json
{"capture": true, "fields": ["prompt","response","token_ids"], "retain_days": 7, "store": "s3://redwood-debug/encrypted/"}
```

Maria: ok that helps. also need the ticket number and a named list of people who will be granted access. no external contractors unless reviewed. add an audit event when someone reads the blob.

audit-bot: audit note queued — please add ticket reference. recommended TTL override limit: 14 days max per policy.

Anya: will open a short-lived ticket and tag legal + product. access list: @Kevin, @Anya, @Suresh (oncall ML). only for debugging this one session. will add an audit hook.

Kevin: adding an extra safety layer — raw blob encrypted with KMS key debug-1, and an HMAC of the prompt stored separately so we can verify without exposing content. quick purge command if we need to remove earlier: `aws s3 rm s3://redwood-debug/encrypted/<object-key>`

Maria: conditions for approval: (1) single session only, (2) retention = 7 days enforced by lifecycle rule, (3) customer id hashed (sha256) before storage, (4) legal signs off for customer data, (5) access restricted to eng-debug IAM group and logged. if all true, i approve.

sec-bot: security approval recorded by Maria. ticket placeholder required before capture begins.

Anya: thanks — will create ticket INC-2026-339, attach capture config, and ping when ready. stopping capture if legal says no. :thumbsup:
